entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-23
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [Performance] Debug Performance in MAUI is considerably slower than Release mode #31309
    .NET 11 Planning
  • [NET10.0] Unable to deploy basic template on ios/android in release mode #31308
    .NET 10.0-rc2

Closed

    .NET 10.0-rc1
  • Camera permission not checked on Windows (WinUI) #31299
  • [REGRESSION, 9.0.90, since 9.0.51] OnPropertyChanged events fire very inconsistently for custom controls #30999
